verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms monday.com serves an llms.txt at developer.monday.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) covering its Platform API documentation, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is also served at a well-known path, adding agent-consumable documentation. missing for 10: first-party docs describing or promoting the llms.txt/agent-oriented docs, evidence of how complete the llms.txt is (e.g. full-content variants or coverage beyond the API reference).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://developer.monday.com/llms.txt # monday.com Platform API Documentation
